title: Retry-hold predicate doesn't mirror dedicated_cleanup_holds_admission, so a stuck dedicated cleanup is reported as an automatic retry
outcome: While record.dedicated_cleanup_holds_admission() holds a session's retry, the session's queueHold and its mailbox wake disposition don't claim an automatic retry that will run by itself.
acceptance: engram_automatic_retry_hold (src/engram_retry_hold.rs) returns None while record.dedicated_cleanup_holds_admission() holds, mirroring engram_admission_retry_step and engram_bind_retry_step (they Wait) and the *_releases checks (they require it false), or else it names the hold distinctly; either way it never says 'no action is needed' for a cleanup that won't clear by itself.

A regression test drives a real dedicated-cleanup hold over a scheduled automatic retry and asserts the plain-pause projection (full and summary queueHold absent, disposition heldBehindPausedQueue) while the cleanup holds, and the automatic-retry projection once it clears.
